template.name: Crypto Analysis
template.entry_long: close > bb_mid(close,{p0}) and close < bb_upper(close,{p1}) and ema(close,{p2}) > ema(close,50) and crossabove(macd(close,12,26),macd_signal(close,12,26,9))
template.notes: The band-tag breakout is expressed as price reclaiming the Bollinger middle band inside the envelope with the documented trend filter (fast EMA above slow EMA, LWMA proxied by EMA 20/50) and a MACD confirmation. Bollinger 20/2 and MACD 12/26/9 are fallbacks; the higher-timeframe burst, monthly filter, money-based trailing and pip/percent protection are not expressible.
